name: Storm Twin
description: Throw two fists in the school's pairing so the second follows the first into the same opening.

name: Echoed Guard
description: Hold two small storms at either shoulder so that each covers the line the other leaves open.

name: Pair Glide
description: Glide forward on a wind from one storm and a pull from the other without a pause.

name: Duet Flicker
description: Cast two bolts one after the other from the twin storms so the second hits the opening of the first.

name: Twin Seal
description: Close both storms on the opponent's chest to shut his qi flow for the length of a breath.

name: Answer Pair
description: Turn aside a blow with one storm and return it with the other in a single movement.

name: Storm Duet
description: Raise both storms high and let them break in turn across the field in a long double crash.

name: Pair Barrier
description: Stand the twin storms before the user as a double barrier that holds against a strong blow.

name: Dual Maelstrom
description: Wind the twin storms into one dual maelstrom that drags everything near into a crushing spin.

name: Twin Verdict
description: The school's closing move that closes both storms on the foe with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Guard Thunder
description: Answer a blow by striking at the same height with the opposite hand and a peal of thunder qi.

name: Twinned Shield
description: Hold the left forearm and the right forearm as two separate thunder guards covering different lines.

name: Ward Step
description: Advance behind the guard in a short step with the forward shield never dropping.

name: Thunder Rebuff
description: Rebuff a strike with the first peal and open the line for the second.

name: Return Peal
description: Catch a thrown technique in one guard and release it from the other as a peal.

name: Shield Bind
description: Pin a striking arm between the two guards and hold it there under the thunder's weight.

name: Rally Peal
description: Sound a steady peal at an ally's back that braces his guard and steadies his hands.

name: Guarding Storm
description: Keep a ring of guarding storm about the user that shields and strikes those who press near.

name: Thunder Bulwark
description: Build a bulwark of paired thunder before the user and allies that no single blow can break.

name: Absorbing Peal
description: Take a striking force into the guard as a deep peal and turn it into mending warmth for an ally.

name: Thunder Aegis
description: The school's closing move that throws paired thunder guards round the user with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Storm Slap
description: Slap with an open hand full of stored storm qi that spills across the struck body.

name: Deep Guard
description: Sink the stance and let deep still qi rise through the legs to receive a hit.

name: Rill Step
description: Run a short quick step along a thin current of rain qi laid ahead on the ground.

name: Spill Bolt
description: Tip the held qi forward and spill a heavy bolt over the target's head and shoulders.

name: Silt Binding
description: Thicken the rain about the feet with silt qi until the legs sink and hold.

name: Eddy Parry
description: Spin a quick eddy about the forearm to turn a strike into a wide arc.

name: Flood Squall
description: Open the basin and send a low flood of squall qi that sweeps the whole ground ahead.

name: Rain Renewal
description: Pour the clear rain of the basin over an ally to close wounds and ward off the next blow.

name: Flood Crest
description: Raise the crest of a flood over the foes and drop it so that it crushes and holds them.

name: Storm Overrun
description: The school's closing move that empties the whole basin over the field as one flood with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Track Fist
description: Drive a fist along a fixed line of qi so the blow lands exactly on the aimed point.

name: Twofold Screen
description: Spread two screens of qi one behind the other so a hit breaks the first and slows.

name: Rail Step
description: Skim along a taut line of qi in a quick straight step that cannot be turned aside.

name: Parallel Cast
description: Cast two thin bolts along side-by-side lines to strike at the same moment.

name: Crossing Bolt
description: Send a bolt along each track so that they cross inside the target's guard.

name: Track Lock
description: Lay both tracks across the opponent's limbs and draw them tight to hold him still.

name: Lined Veil
description: Run two veils of storm qi alongside the body so that blows slide down between them.

name: Merge Burst
description: Bring the two tracks together in the palm and burst them against the target at once.

name: Crown Strike
description: Meet the tracks above the head and bring the crown down in a single heavy blow with a wide burst.

name: Track Mantle
description: Run the tracks round the user and allies in a mantle that shields them and feeds their power.

name: Crowned Tempest
description: Gather the two tracks of storm into one crowned tempest and let it break over the whole field.

name: Twin Crown
description: The school's crowning move that sets both tracks meeting overhead and drops one storm with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Oath Squall
description: Strike with a palm that carries a sworn squall and holds it to the target until it breaks.

name: Tethered Guard
description: Hold a vow-bound guard of wind that does not drop while the user keeps the promise.

name: Sworn Stride
description: Stride forward on the wind that the user has sworn to and let it lengthen the step.

name: Pledge Gust
description: Loose a hard gust from the open hand that knocks weapons and balance off line.

name: Clasping Wind
description: Bind the opponent's arms with a held wind that tightens each time he strains.

name: Bearing Parry
description: Turn a strike along the taken bearing so that it passes behind the user's shoulder.

name: Windsworn Rush
description: Rush the whole length of the field on the sworn wind and strike with its full speed.

name: Vow Canopy
description: Spread a cover of sworn wind over the user and one near ally against blows from above.

name: Squall Oath
description: Speak the squall oath aloud and let the sworn storm press down on all who oppose it.

name: Last Oath
description: The school's closing move that spends the last sworn qi in one squall with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Flat Fist
description: Hit level from a broad stance with a plain low roll of thunder qi behind the blow.

name: Broadsheet Guard
description: Hold both arms wide in a broad screen of qi that bears a blow evenly.

name: Open Stride
description: Take an easy long stride across open ground with a flat push of wind at the heels.

name: Peal Stamp
description: Stamp so that a flat shock of thunder runs outward through the ground and unsteadies all near.

name: Flat Peal
description: Clap a flat peal at the opponent's ear so that his balance and his aim are lost.

name: Level Parry
description: Sweep a level arm across the body to turn a strike off its line.

name: Plateau Mend
description: Lay a broad warm palm of settling storm qi on an ally's wound to close it slowly.

name: Rolling Thunder
description: Send a long roll of thunder along the ground that shakes all it passes beneath.

name: Even Ward
description: Spread an even ward over the user and allies that shields them and keeps their footing sure.

name: Unbroken Thunder
description: Hold a thunder that does not break across the open ground and strike with the whole of it.

name: Plateau Fall
description: The school's closing move that lets the whole level thunder fall on the foe with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Stormsworn Fist
description: Throw a fist that is sworn to the storm and carries a held peal to the point of impact.

name: Storm Cover
description: Draw a cover of sworn storm qi over the shoulders that takes the first blow.

name: Sworn Hop
description: Hop away from a blow on a short hard gust sworn to the user's heels.

name: Pledge Needle
description: Throw a needle of sworn rain at the opponent's eye line that holds true to the aim.

name: Storm Binding
description: Wind sworn storm qi round the target's legs and bind him in place on the field.

name: Bearing Lash
description: Lash along the bearing of the target to break his stance with a hard thin whip.

name: Draft Parry
description: Meet a strike with a short gust from the open hand and send it wide.

name: Tempest Mending
description: Run a mending breath of the sworn storm through an ally to close cuts and quiet the pulse.

name: Storm Oath
description: Swear the storm to the field and let it burst over foes in a wide and ruinous blow.

name: Oathward Mantle
description: Cloak the user and sworn companions in a mantle of oath-bound storm that steadies and strengthens.

name: Stormsworn Reckoning
description: Reckon the sworn storm against the foes and press it down upon them in a great crushing mass.

name: Storm Covenant
description: The school's closing move that breaks the sworn storm on foes and strengthens allies with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Taproot Fist
description: Drive a fist up from a stance rooted deep so the force climbs out of the ground.

name: Rooted Guard
description: Run storm qi down into the ground through both legs so that no blow can shift the user.

name: Rooted Step
description: Walk with each foot set down firmly like a root and the wind pulling the body onward.

name: Rooted Bolt
description: Draw a bolt of lightning up the leg from the ground and loose it from the palm.

name: Sworn Roots
description: Send roots of sworn storm qi through the ground to seize the opponent's feet.

name: Oath Rebuke
description: Rebuke a strike with a short heavy bump of the shoulder that turns it off its line.

name: Deep Thunder
description: Raise thunder from deep below the feet and break it upward through the target.

name: Rooted Canopy
description: Spread a canopy of storm on roots from the ground that stands over the user and allies.

name: Undertempest
description: Pull a tempest up from under the field so that it breaks upward and presses the foes down again.

name: Oath Rising
description: The school's deepest move that raises the oath from the ground as one storm with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.
